_rationale: Accumulation-only with standardized-t (df=6). Deterministic growth path lands near 500000 * 1.054^15 ≈ $1.1M; with unit-variance t-shocks the realized variance is the same as log-normal, so the median should fall in a broad range around that expected value. 100% success is guaranteed because there are no withdrawals and growth factors are strictly positive. The range is broad enough to tolerate t-distribution kurtosis without being so loose that the assertion is meaningless.
